component.name: MEDHā IDE
component.summary: Native PySide6 offline IDE for C/C++/Python

description.p: MEDHā is a native desktop IDE written in Python with PySide6 (Qt 6). It is offline-first: everything works without internet except searching/downloading extensions from Open VSX. No Electron, no web views, no bundled browsers. It integrates your system toolchain (gcc, g++, gdb, python3, clangd, pylsp, cmake, git, ollama) into a single window with dockable panels.

ul.li: Multi-tab code editor with syntax highlighting
Real compilation & execution (gcc/g++/python3)
Integrated terminal (real shell via QProcess)
Problems panel (parses compiler stderr)
LSP client — clangd (C/C++), pylsp (Python)
GDB debugger (C/C++) + debugpy (Python)
Git status, stage, commit, log, diff
CMake configure & build (multi-target Debug/Release)
Live disassembly (gcc -S)
Project explorer
Local Ollama AI chat panel
Open VSX extensions: themes, snippets, grammar subset
Memory visualizer & pointer inspector
DSA visualizer (arrays, trees, graphs)
Symbol outline
Static safety linter (cppcheck integration)
No VS Code JavaScript extensions — only Open VSX extensions that are pure data (themes, snippets, TextMate grammars). Node.js-based extensions (language servers, debuggers, formatters) cannot run.
LSP requires external binaries — clangd for C/C++, pylsp for Python. Install them separately; MEDHā will auto-detect if on PATH.
Debugpy for Python — install via pip install debugpy (or --break-system-packages).
No bundled compilers/runtimes — uses your system gcc, g++, python3, cmake, git.
Linux-first — Wayland/X11 via Qt. Windows/macOS untested.
No web browser, no Monaco, no LibreOffice, no VLC, no game engine — those were in the archived legacy/ prototype.

description.p: First public release for Snap Store.

ul.li: Native PySide6 IDE with real compiler runs, terminal, LSP, GDB/debugpy debugger
Git integration, CMake build system, local Ollama AI panel
Open VSX extensions (themes, snippets, grammar subset)
Memory visualizer, DSA visualizer, live disassembly, static safety linter
Classic confinement snap for full system toolchain access
